maria_cs: Heads up — our 'onboarding touchpoint lag' alert fired ~1,100 times overnight, a lot of false positives from trial accounts. Flagging for triage. :grimacing:
playbook-bot: rule onboarding_touchpoint_lag triggered 1134 accounts; sample -> acct_id=52341 last_touch=2026-03-18T09:12Z stage=trial
jake_ops: omg that's noisy. any pattern in regions or account age?
kai_data: quick look — most are <7d accounts with no webhook events; alert window is 72h right now. I'd suggest increasing to 96h for trial tier.
oliver_se: can we whitelist accounts created via the 'partner-import' flow? those delay initial touchpoints for a day.
sophia_pm: need to consider product impact — longer window delays detection of real onboarding gaps. what's the business cost vs churn risk?
maria_cs: roughly 50% of the flagged were contacted already but not logged in CRM due to webhook failures. So this is more signal reliability than adoption.
playbook-bot: recent run details: rule_id=onboarding_touchpoint_lag v2.3; query_time=2026-03-21T02:14Z; affected_segments=[trial, pql-lite]
jake_ops: can we patch the rule to exclude accounts with 'partner-import' tag and created_at < 48h? that should cut noise fast.
kai_data: sample SQL to find noisy accounts — run in analytics:
```sql
SELECT account_id, created_at, last_touch_at, lifecycle_stage
FROM onboarding_events
WHERE last_touch_at IS NULL
  AND created_at >= current_date - interval '14 days'
  AND lifecycle_stage IN ('trial','pql-lite')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
maria_cs: perfect, i'll run that and paste a sample list.
(some minutes later)
maria_cs: pasted 12 account IDs to #cs-desk; most show 'webhook_retry' in logs.
oliver_se: I'll open a Jira to capture changes + backfill. CS-3421 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3421
oliver_se: plan: 1) short-term rule tweak (exclude partner-import + bump 72->96h for trials) 2) one-time backfill to reconcile contacts for flagged accounts 3) infra work to reduce webhook retry gaps
sophia_pm: agree. also want a quick A/B: adjust rule for 48h vs 96h on small cohort and measure false positive rate. can we track KPIs? :bar_chart:
maria_cs: will capture FP rate and renewal-risk spike (if any) in the ticket. assigning to @oliver_se and @kai_data. :memo:
jake_ops: i can ship the rule change — PR up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/789 — needs review and a canary deploy.
playbook-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to cs-ingest-prod at 2026-03-21T09:00Z by jake_ops
oliver_se: i'll own the backfill job, will use the SQL above and write to `cs_touchpoint_backfill` with idempotent writes. will post ETA in CS-3421.
maria_cs: thanks all. next sync in async — we'll review post-canary numbers tomorrow. :+1:
